exposure: Candidate vs. non-candidate for normal birth
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 3315 women who gave birth at a tertiary hospital in Cantabria, Spain, between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2014.
finding: Women identified as candidates for normal birth had lower rates of episiotomy, cesarean section, instrumental birth, perineal tears, and neonatal intensive care unit admissions compared to non-candidates.
